independent_verification.recovered_law: The agents of destruction (four angels releasing cavalry to kill a third of humanity) are replaced by four 'silences' that seal the speech of those already consenting to die — the direction reverses from external violent killing to an internal sealing/suppression of voice, and the military agency (armies, horses) becomes abstract carriers ('propositions of the throat,' 'burdens') acting on language rather than on people.
independent_verification.law_match_note: Both involve internalized destruction through suppressed speech/silence, but the declared claim focuses on utterance as irreversible organic cost to the speaker, while the recovered claim describes a reversal from external killing agents to internal sealing of voice with agency shifted from military forces to abstract linguistic carriers — related structural territory but different specific relational changes.
independent_verification.terminal_note: The final portion of TEXT B maintains the changed relation: horses become 'burdens,' mouths become 'openings,' and fire/smoke/sulfur become 'burning/darkening/residue of sulfur' — the relational shift from martial destruction to suppression of voice persists.

law_variance.declared: Speech held back long enough becomes a body inside the body, and when it finally moves through the throat it does not leave the speaker intact but kills the specific silence it once was — so that utterance is not expression but an irreversible organic cost, a portion of interior territory permanently altered by what passed through it.
